Package com.airtribe.meditrack.entity

Class Appointment

java.lang.Object
com.airtribe.meditrack.entity.MedicalEntity
com.airtribe.meditrack.entity.Appointment
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Appointment extends MedicalEntity implements Cloneable
A booked slot between a Patient and a Doctor.

Implements Cloneable to demonstrate deep-copy semantics on a more complex object graph than Patient alone: cloning an appointment deep-copies the nested Patient (so editing the clone's patient record doesn't leak back into the original appointment) but deliberately keeps the Doctor reference shared â€” doctors are catalog entities owned by DoctorService, not state that belongs to any one appointment, so copying one would just desync it from the doctor roster.
